workLog.action: found a test that could not observe the defect it was named for
workLog.evidence: test_a_trailing_slash_on_the_worktree_path_is_tolerated in tests/test_gc_worktrees_occupancy.py passed with the defect present, because its cwd was a subdirectory and the prefix branch matches whether or not the left operand is normalized.

workLog.action: identified why coverage could not have caught it
workLog.evidence: In the short-circuit disjunction the defective operand executes, yields the wrong value, and the sibling operand supplies the right answer, so the line is covered and the branch is taken while the assertion still holds.

workLog.action: found the sole discriminating input and proved it
workLog.evidence: A cwd equal to the worktree root is the only input on which the fixed and unfixed implementations disagree. It failed on its first run once added, and the control showed the original test passing with the defect either present or absent.

workLog.action: wrote the rule to the canonical file and regenerated both mirrors
workLog.evidence: Added SHOULD 9 to .claude/rules/testing.md, with the identical text mirrored to .github/instructions/testing.instructions.md and src/copilot-cli/instructions/testing.instructions.md so Claude, Codex and Copilot all inherit it.

workLog.action: checked the diff shape before proposing it as a pull request
workLog.evidence: git diff against the origin/main tip showed 35 files and 3001 deletions, which reads as a mass revert. Diffing against the merge base instead showed the true change: 3 files, 3 insertions. The branch was 4 commits behind main, and those 4 commits' additions appear as deletions when the tip is used as the left side.
